03About

Behavior is the interface.

Background

I’m Jack Motzkin. I live in the Southwest, I’m an Eagle Scout, and I have a B.A. in Psychology with a minor in Sociology. In my senior year I decided to apply that background to user experience. After graduating I completed PeakXD’s international UX research and design program and earned my BCS certificate in UX and the IBM Data Science certificate.

My work so far

I’ve done research for a charity in Australia, a dispensary in Washington and a pack-out company in Arizona. At Veeam I do the same kind of work with employees, using surveys to find out what isn’t working in the office and changing it.

What I’m looking for

Opportunities to keep building my UX research experience, on projects with teams that build with their users, not around them. I want to go deep on research first and grow into design from there.
